content: The title of Section 6 in the American Diabetes Association (ADA) Standards of Care has been revised to Glycemic Goals and Hypoglycemia. All content related to hypoglycemia throughout the document has been consolidated into this section for clarity and focus. 1. The section has been updated to emphasize the need for more frequent glycemic assessments in populations requiring closer monitoring, ensuring that their blood glucose levels are managed effectively. 2. Recommendations for the use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems and specific glycemic targets have been incorporated to enhance patient care and outcomes. Updates have been made to sections addressing glucose-lowering treatments, with a focus on their long-term microvascular and cardiovascular benefits. These updates are based on evidence from recent studies demonstrating the advantages of newer diabetes medications. Section 8b has been added to provide guidance on scenarios where deintensification of diabetes medications may be appropriate, such as in cases of overtreatment or when patient-specific factors warrant a less aggressive approach. Section 11c has been introduced to assist healthcare providers in reviewing a patient’s history of hypoglycemia, their awareness of hypoglycemic episodes, and their individual risk factors. This aims to improve the management and prevention of hypoglycemia in clinical practice.
